title: SG-6.5 · Show the current World and wire the admin duration and limit fields
summary: Admin console shows the current World, sends the duration to the backend, and disables the contribution-limit field because no endpoint exists
description: Context: AdminApp (game/frontend/src/components/AdminApp.tsx) heading prints only the constant WORLD_ID, and its Duration (hours) and Max contributions per player inputs only change local state and are never sent anywhere. Desired behavior: show the World title, send the duration to POST /api/v1/admin/rounds, and disable the contribution-limit input because the backend has no endpoint for it (the limit comes from config contribution.max_per_player). Expected result: no admin field looks active while doing nothing. Why: the admin must not be misled about what they configure.
acceptance_criteria: Given the admin is authenticated, when AdminApp loads, then the World title from GET /api/v1/worlds/{id} is displayed.
Given the admin sets Duration to 12 and clicks Create round, when the request is sent, then POST /api/v1/admin/rounds carries world_id and duration "12h".
Given no backend endpoint sets the contribution limit, when AdminApp renders, then the Max contributions per player input is disabled and an explanatory note is visible.
Each behavior is covered by a frontend unit test with mocked fetch.

preserve: Token gate, Open/Close round, ExecutionPanel and 401 behavior

technical_constraints: Frontend only; use existing adminRequest helper
Backend create contract: JSON body {world_id, starts_at, duration (Go duration string), base_release}
definition_of_done: All three requirements implemented and their unit tests pass
